Event design

Building Lasting Change

Three years of event design across print, digital and on-site experiences

Event
Building Lasting Change (BLC)
Client
Canada Green Building Council (CAGBC)
Years
2024–2026
Role
Creative Lead
Scope
Event Branding · Digital · Print · On-site Graphics

Across three consecutive years, I led the visual design for Building Lasting Change, developing cohesive event experiences across digital, print, and on-site touchpoints.

From large-format signage and promotional campaigns to animated wayfinding screens, conference materials, and branded merchandise, I brought the event’s visual identity to life across every stage of the attendee experience.

In 2025 alone, this included over 50 animated wayfinding screens, alongside a wide range of event and promotional assets.

01   Screens & ads

On-site and
digital

I developed digital campaign assets, conference schedules, registration graphics, and over 50 animated wayfinding screens for the 2025 event.

Working across English and French, I maintained a consistent visual language that connected the event’s promotional presence with its on-site experience.

02   Print

Print and
signage

From roll-ups and standees to schedule boards, gala menus, and newspaper ads, I extended the event identity across a wide range of physical applications.

Each piece was designed to maintain clarity, consistency, and visibility throughout the venue.

03   Event materials

The details that
bring it together

I designed attendee ID cards and staff T-shirts, extending the event’s visual identity into the smaller details that supported both guests and event operations.
